//msbuild-sdks: MSBuild project SDK versions. NuGet packages are pinned in
Directory.Packages.props, but an <Project Sdk="..."> attribute needs a version
before restore runs, so MSBuild SDKs are versioned here instead. The AppHost
references Aspire.AppHost.Sdk *without* a version, and the number lives only
in this file - upgrade Aspire by editing this one line.
